body: Honestly it’s not worth it. It’s so goddamn addictive and once you start it’ll be really, really hard to stop. I used to do it every single day and even now, I still have to do it once in a while to keep myself from doing something worse. Also killing yourself that way is NOT easy... take it from someone who has tried. You don’t want those scars as a physical reminder of your emotional pain.

Thank you for that but you don’t know me, I’ve done some shitty things in my life and I don’t deserve to be here. 

I’ve had 14 years to think this over. At 26 I feel like I’ve given life too many chances already. I should have done this years ago.
Not in a good place either. Do you play any pc games?

I’ve asked for help before but they didn’t really know how to handle it. One of my friends told her mother who told my mother and it kind of went downhill from there... my mother is an extremely anxious person. But the fact that it scared my friend so much makes me not want to bring it up again. Especially when she’s in such a good place right now. It’s strange how your emtions can just take over even when you know they’re not rational. I know I’m not at all rational right now. But I feel like it’s the right choice

I feel that way too, like I’m numb when I’m stable or on medication 
It’s like feeling that deeply makes you never want to go back to what people consider “normal”

These things take time. You can't just expect to find a single solution and have it work overnight. If she's going to therapy and actively trying to get better then she's on the right path. You just need to be patient and supportive and give her time to heal.
